description: This file contains the implementation of the ImmutableMessageHeaders class, which is an immutable class representing message headers in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to access specific header fields such as direction, subject, thing entity ID, feature ID, timestamp, and status code.

classes.name: ImmutableMessageHeaders
classes.description: Immutable implementation of MessageHeaders, extending AbstractDittoHeaders, providing accessors for message header fields.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableMessageHeaders instance wrapping the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the message direction from headers, converting the string to MessageDirection enum.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the ThingId associated with the message headers.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the feature ID from headers.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the timestamp as OffsetDateTime.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the HTTP status code.

methods.name: getSpecificDefinitionByKey
methods.description: Retrieves specific header definition by key, checking both DittoHeaderDefinition and MessageHeaderDefinition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
